segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to your channel HSE study guide
segments.zh: 朋友们好，欢迎来到你们的频道 HSE Study Guide。

segments.text: Today in this video we are going to talk about fire extinguisher's mcq test
segments.zh: 今天在这个视频中，我们要讲的是灭火器的选择题测试，

segments.text: i.e. we will talk about fire extinguisher's safety knowledge
segments.zh: 也就是说，我们要讲灭火器的安全知识，

segments.text: through which your test will also be done
segments.zh: 通过它也可以给你们做个测试。

segments.text: So let's start the video
segments.zh: 那我们开始视频吧。

segments.text: So the first question is that whenever you discover fire
segments.zh: 第一题是：每当你发现火情时，

segments.text: what should you do?
segments.zh: 你应该怎么做？

segments.text: So the first option is that you have to run away from the fire in the building
segments.zh: 第一个选项是你要从着火的建筑物里跑出去，

segments.text: and do not warn any other person
segments.zh: 而且不要警告任何其他人。

segments.text: Then the option is given that you have to use the fire extinguisher
segments.zh: 然后给出的选项是你要使用灭火器

segments.text: to extinguish the fire
segments.zh: 来扑灭火灾，

segments.text: Until you have never used the fire extinguisher before
segments.zh: 即使你以前从未用过灭火器，

segments.text: even then you can use the fire extinguisher to extinguish the fire
segments.zh: 也可以用灭火器来灭火。

segments.text: Then the point is that you have to stay in the building
segments.zh: 然后一项是你要留在建筑物里，

segments.text: until you find a way to extinguish the fire
segments.zh: 直到你找到灭火的办法。

segments.text: And option D is that you have to pull the fire alarm and call the fire department
segments.zh: 选项 D 是你要拉下火灾报警器并打电话给消防部门。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D is that you have to pull the fire alarm and call the fire department
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D，你要拉下火灾报警器并打电话给消防部门。

segments.text: Then the next question is that what is the pass stand for
segments.zh: 下一题是：PASS 代表什么？

segments.text: So option A is push, arm, shoot, sweep
segments.zh: 选项 A 是 Push、Aim、Shoot、Sweep，

segments.text: Option B is push, arm, shoot, shoot, shoot
segments.zh: 选项 B 是 Push、Aim、Shoot、Shoot、Shoot，

segments.text: Option C is pull, arm, squeeze, sweep
segments.zh: 选项 C 是 Pull、Aim、Squeeze、Sweep，

segments.text: And option D is pull, arm, shoot, squeeze
segments.zh: 选项 D 是 Pull、Aim、Shoot、Squeeze。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is that the pass stand for is option C is pull, arm, squeeze, sweep
segments.zh: 正确答案是，PASS 代表的是选项 C：Pull、Aim、Squeeze、Sweep，

segments.text: That means pull the pin, aim at the base of fire, squeeze the lever and sweep from side by side
segments.zh: 意思是拔出保险销、对准火焰根部、压下把手、左右扫射。

segments.text: Then the question is that whenever you are trying to extinguish the fire
segments.zh: 下一题是：每当你试图灭火时，

segments.text: then the aim of the fire extinguisher should be kept there
segments.zh: 灭火器应该对准哪里？

segments.text: So option A is that you should keep the aim away from the fire
segments.zh: 选项 A 是你应该对准远离火的地方。

segments.text: Option B is that you should aim at the top of the fire
segments.zh: 选项 B 是你应该对准火焰顶部。

segments.text: Option D is that you should aim at the center of the fire
segments.zh: 选项 D 是你应该对准火焰中心。

segments.text: And option D is that you should aim at the base of the fire
segments.zh: 选项 D 是你应该对准火焰根部。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D is that you have to aim at the base of fire
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D，你要对准火焰根部。

segments.text: Then the next question is that the carbon dioxide fire extinguisher is rated for which fire
segments.zh: 下一题是：二氧化碳灭火器适用于哪类火灾？

segments.text: So option A is that of class D
segments.zh: 选项 A 是 D 类，

segments.text: Option B is that of class A and class D
segments.zh: 选项 B 是 A 类和 D 类，

segments.text: Option C is that of class C
segments.zh: 选项 C 是 C 类，

segments.text: And option D is that of class B and class C
segments.zh: 选项 D 是 B 类和 C 类。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D, class B and class C
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D，B 类和 C 类。

segments.text: Then the next question is that whenever you are trying to extinguish the fire
segments.zh: 下一题是：每当你试图灭火时，

segments.text: That means you are fighting with the fire
segments.zh: 也就是你在与火搏斗时，

segments.text: So at that time your back is the fire exit
segments.zh: 那时你的背后应是安全出口，

segments.text: Or wherever you want to escape from
segments.zh: 或者你想要逃离的方向，

segments.text: So your back should be towards that
segments.zh: 你的背应该朝向那里。

segments.text: So this sentence is true or false
segments.zh: 这句话是对还是错？

segments.text: So option A is true and option B is false
segments.zh: 选项 A 是对，选项 B 是错。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option A is that this sentence is true
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 A，这句话是对的。

segments.text: Then the next question is that what are the three elements of fire triangle
segments.zh: 下一题是：燃烧三角形的三个要素是什么？

segments.text: So option A is water, heat source and fuel
segments.zh: 选项 A 是水、热源和燃料，

segments.text: Option B is oxygen, water and fuel
segments.zh: 选项 B 是氧气、水和燃料，

segments.text: Option C is oxygen, fuel and heat source
segments.zh: 选项 C 是氧气、燃料和热源，

segments.text: And option D is fuel, oxygen and earth
segments.zh: 选项 D 是燃料、氧气和土。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option C, oxygen, fuel and heat source
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 C，氧气、燃料和热源。

segments.text: Then the next question is that what is involved in class A fire
segments.zh: 下一题是：A 类火灾涉及什么？

segments.text: So for that option A is given, ordinary combustible material
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是普通可燃材料，

segments.text: Option B is given, flammable liquid material
segments.zh: 选项 B 是易燃液体物质，

segments.text: Option C is given, electrical equipment materials
segments.zh: 选项 C 是电气设备材料，

segments.text: And option D is given, flammable metals
segments.zh: 选项 D 是易燃金属。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option A, ordinary combustible material
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 A，普通可燃材料。

segments.text: Then the next question is that dry chemical
segments.zh: 下一题是：干粉，

segments.text: That means DCP which is tri-class fire extinguisher
segments.zh: 也就是 DCP，它是三类通用灭火器，

segments.text: So it should be used above this class of fire
segments.zh: 它应该用于哪一类火灾？

segments.text: So option A is given, class A is fire
segments.zh: 给出的选项 A 是 A 类火灾，

segments.text: Option B is given, class B is fire
segments.zh: 选项 B 是 B 类火灾，

segments.text: Option C is given, class C is fire
segments.zh: 选项 C 是 C 类火灾，

segments.text: And option D is given, all these
segments.zh: 选项 D 是以上全部。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D, all of the above
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D，以上全部。

segments.text: Then the next question is that pressurized water extinguisher
segments.zh: 下一题是：加压水型灭火器

segments.text: Which extinguishing method works
segments.zh: 采用的是哪种灭火方法？

segments.text: So option A is given, cooling method
segments.zh: 给出的选项 A 是冷却法，

segments.text: Option B is given, oxygen exclusion
segments.zh: 选项 B 是隔绝氧气，

segments.text: Option C is given, fuel removal
segments.zh: 选项 C 是移除燃料，

segments.text: And option D is given, chemical chain reaction
segments.zh: 选项 D 是化学链式反应。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option A, cooling
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 A，冷却。

segments.text: And then the next question is
segments.zh: 然后下一题是：

segments.text: Which is the most common fire extinguisher
segments.zh: 最常见的灭火器

segments.text: Which is found
segments.zh: 是哪一种？

segments.text: So option A is given, water extinguisher
segments.zh: 给出的选项 A 是水型灭火器，

segments.text: Option B is given, dry chemical extinguisher
segments.zh: 选项 B 是干粉灭火器，

segments.text: Option C is given, halone extinguisher
segments.zh: 选项 C 是哈龙灭火器，

segments.text: And option D is given, foam extinguisher
segments.zh: 选项 D 是泡沫灭火器。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option B, dry chemical extinguisher
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 B，干粉灭火器。

segments.text: So friends, I hope that you got to know
segments.zh: 所以朋友们，我希望你们已经了解了

segments.text: About the basic safety knowledge of fire extinguisher
segments.zh: 灭火器的基本安全知识，

segments.text: That too through MCQ test
segments.zh: 而且是通过选择题测试的方式。

segments.text: So that's all for today, with a new topic
segments.zh: 今天就到这里，带着新话题再见，

segments.text: Till then take care, bye-bye
segments.zh: 在那之前请多保重，再见。
